inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: The real issue is whether public resources are being exploited while people with political power escape scrutiny. KT Rama Rao has accused the Congress government of failing to act on illegal mining and alleged that Raghava Constructions, linked to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved. Those claims need a transparent, independent investigation—not dismissal as political infighting. Communities should not bear the costs while powerful interests profit, and the same rules must apply to everyone.
